description: Storytime Level 2 card line-art retry: ham line art (up to 2 more tries, slice with a fat rim and no plate) and family line art (up to 3 more tries, thicker strokes), from the passed color files; delivery v2 and handoff update; spend 0.05 USD at most inside the 1.60 USD card limit
deviation_notes: Created from the PM request of 2026-11-07 (follows the archived tracks asset_storytime_l2_cards_20261106 and asset_storytime_l2_family_words_20261107, which are not dependency ids because they are archived). Whole track on the PM light lane of 2026-11-03: one maker (measure-jr-green), one checker (measure-phase-acceptance), then closeout; no spec review, strategy, Red, review, adversarial, or final acceptance role. A per-row line retry allowance goes into scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs (ham 2, family 3, counted from a retry start time that the maker sets from the real UTC time); CARD_RUN stays byte equal. Ham line prompt draws the slice only with no plate, and the ham mustShow loses the plate phrase (default, open to a PM change). The family line prompt follows a fixed ladder E4 to E6 for thicker strokes; a try below 12 px goes to no judge. The delivery is a new folder delivery-muse-v2; the 58 old files keep their bytes. A row that fails all tries is reported with its best try and its color file goes to the handoff folder. The delivery is model evidence, not acceptance. The registry entry is staged through a blob because measure/tracks.md holds a foreign uncommitted hunk. The generator is not run because measure/generated/ holds foreign changes.
